title: How You Can Lose More Than 100%
hook: Buy a stock and the most you can lose is everything. Short one and you can lose more. GameStop went from about $20 to $483 in January 2021.
sources: US SEC Staff Report (October 2021): GME closed $347.51 on Jan 27 and hit an intraday $483.00 on Jan 28, 2021; Jan 11 close about $20
tags: short selling, lose more than 100, GameStop, short squeeze, stocks explained, shorts
